subtitle: Lesson 48 · MySQL Performance Tuning

code:
"Just add an index"
"Just bump the buffer pool"

...without measuring first = guessing
An added index can speed up reads
  and slow down every write
caption: No baseline means no way to verify a change actually helped.

code:
slow query log     -> what's actually slow
EXPLAIN             -> why a query is slow
Performance Schema  -> low-level instrumentation
sys schema          -> friendlier view layer
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS   -> quick health counters
caption: Same loop as SQL Server tuning — different instrumentation underneath.
